{"task": {"id": "I_kwDONElfw88AAAABY2X-Tg", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BlV6PzhCb9uM", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4BlV6P", "number": 104, "title": "Prepare @takahirox/three-mmd 0.1.2 for manual npm publication", "body": "## Problem

The maintainer wants a **new `@takahirox/three-mmd` npm version** containing the latest merged library changes, with a release candidate fully ready for a **single manual `npm publish` run by the maintainer**.

The current `main` package and lockfile declare **0.1.1**. [Issue #94](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/issues/94) and [PR #95](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/pull/95) prepared that version for manual release, but the checked-in [0.1.1 release record](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/blob/main/docs/releases/0.1.1.md) says **prepared, not published**; it does not prove the registry's present state. During this issue filing, direct npm-registry metadata was not accessible; a third-party package index is insufficient to confirm the current set of published versions. **Query the live official npm registry afresh before choosing a version, and never reuse a published version.**

Since that candidate was prepared, `main` has received substantial **library runtime** changes in [#96 / PR #97](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/pull/97): PMX material morph multiply/add composition, texture/sphere/toon sampler blend-control semantics, and MMD-oriented direct diffuse/specular lighting. Subsequent [#98, #100 and #102](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/issues/102) update public Examples lighting and add measured Gene PMX overbrightness diagnostics; these are **Examples/research changes**, not new npm library features.

The maintainer explicitly reserves the real `npm publish` command for themself.

## Expected outcome

Prepare, validate and merge a **new versioned release candidate**, tentatively **`@takahirox/three-mmd@0.1.2`** (subject to fresh authoritative npm registry verification and a valid unused semver choice). Update release-facing metadata/docs to describe the **actual runtime changes** and ship the correct compiled runtime, pinned optional Bullet WASM and legal notices, so an authenticated maintainer can publish it from a clean, up-to-date `main` without further repository edits.

**Hard boundary:** The task MUST NOT execute a real `npm publish`, authenticate to npm, obtain or create credentials/tokens, set up automated publication, publish a tag/release on the maintainer's behalf, or claim a release is live. `npm publish --dry-run --access public` is explicitly allowed.

### Pre-merge acceptance criteria

- [ ] Check the **official** `registry.npmjs.org` online, bypassing stale caches, for this exact scope/package's complete published versions and dist-tags; distinguish verified 200/404 from network/authorization errors. Determine whether **0.1.1 was actually published**. Prefer **0.1.2 if unused** as the next source version above the currently checked-in 0.1.1; if the registry requires another version, explain and document the selection. Avoid using an already published number. If registry status cannot be verified, record the blocker honestly rather than inventing a publish-safe version.
- [ ] Update **`package.json`, top-level `package-lock.json` version and lockfile root-package version** consistently; keep the npm package name exactly `@takahirox/three-mmd`, the GitHub repo name unchanged, and the existing `publishConfig` pointing to the public npm registry.
- [ ] Record the exact source/merge SHA and release differences from the previously published **actual** version. In particular, include [PR #97](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/pull/97)'s PMX material morph and direct-light shader corrections; distinguish the Examples-only adjustments and the documented Gene PMX investigation from changes consumers get in the tarball. Retain the previously prepared Bullet/Worker/physics feature summary if still unpublished in the registry. Do not claim perfect native MMD rendering or a proven solution to rare PMD physics instability.
- [ ] Update `README.md`, `docs/releases.md`, and create/update an appropriate versioned release record (e.g. `docs/releases/0.1.2.md`). Replace outdated "0.1.1 release candidate" language. Include registry evidence, exact release source, known limitations, instructions for root and documented subpath imports, Three.js peer `~0.186.0`, `mmd-parser ^1.1.4`, externally initialized Ammo, the optional pinned Bullet WASM assets and the Worker. No unjustified dependency/peer upgrades.
- [ ] Check `npm pack --dry-run --json` (and a local `npm pack` if needed) to verify all exported ESM/declaration paths, packaged classic Worker, optional pinned Bullet glue/WASM/manifest/licenses, README, LICENSE and third-party notices; ensure assets/hashes are valid. Exclude Examples, downloaded/private/licensed MMD models, fixtures, source-only tooling, secrets and development files.
- [ ] Verify packaged-tarball installation in **isolated JS ESM and strict TypeScript consumers**, with root and documented subpath imports resolved from the actual tarball and no source aliases/registry fallback. Exercise installed WASM/Worker startup in the browser where existing tests cover it.
- [ ] Run and record applicable checks for the *release-candidate tree*: `npm ci`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, `npm run test:legacy`, `npm run test:browser`, `npm run build`, fixture-based Examples build and relevant browser checks, `npm pack --dry-run --json`, `npm publish --dry-run --access public`, and `git diff --check`. Validate that the ordinary publish lifecycle retains `prepack` and `prepublishOnly` gates without requiring actual upload. Do not assert a check passed unless it ran and succeeded.
- [ ] Confirm no accidental real npm publication or automated publish workflow was introduced. Document a **short maintainer handoff** containing selected version, exact source/merge SHA, registry version availability evidence, local and CI results, known non-blocking limitations, and required *external* npm login, scope publishing rights and 2FA/token authorization.
- [ ] Final handoff's one real publication command, to be executed **only by the maintainer** from a clean, updated `main` after their own authentication, is **`npm publish`**. The issue can be completed once the repository candidate is merged and validated; the real registry publication and subjective visual approval are not merge gates.

### Required post-merge verification

- **PENDING until performed:** Record the merge SHA and inspect the **latest attempt** of merge-triggered Tests and GitHub Pages workflows against that **exact SHA**, with run URLs/conclusions. Do not confuse Pages publication with npm publication.
- **PENDING until performed:** Verify the published Pages commit and basic PMD, Gene PMX and Worker demo startup and required JS/WASM paths if applicable. These checks are after merge, not pre-merge PR gates.
- **Reserved for the maintainer, not an agent task:** npm login/authorization, the real `npm publish`, and any subsequent npm registry check/tag. Optionally verify the published package version **after the maintainer has published**; do not require actual npm publication to close this issue.

## Context

- Repository: [takahirox/three-mmd-loader](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader), `main` at filing: `173cc811a88bfc7c2a21dd0cf08ee324b6134334`.
- Current package: `@takahirox/three-mmd@0.1.1` in both `package.json` and `package-lock.json` (checked into `main`).
- Prior release preparation: [#94](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/issues/94), [PR #95](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/pull/95), [manual release guide](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/blob/main/docs/releases.md), [0.1.1 candidate record](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/blob/main/docs/releases/0.1.1.md).
- New material changes: [#96](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/issues/96) / [PR #97](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/pull/97), [MMD shading evidence](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/blob/main/docs/material-shading.md), [material morph semantics](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/blob/main/docs/material-morphs.md).
- Separate Examples trials: [#98](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/issues/98), [#100](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/issues/100), [#102](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/issues/102), [Gene overbrightness investigation](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/blob/main/docs/gene-light-overbrightness-investigation.md).
- The maintainer has explicitly chosen to run `npm publish` manually. **Do not take that action for them.**
